title: SR 44 over Branch of Little Blue River | proposed 2026 slab replacement
source_note: INDOT B-44483 proposed 2026 replacement, document 9683606. The separate 68-page old-plan bundle 9552139 is preserved for provenance but supplies no replacement dimensions. Revision 9710491 changes traffic-control pay quantities, not structural geometry.
status_note: Whole proposed replacement crossing present. Amber: local notches, wing batter, approach transitions, terrain and actual pile behavior remain incomplete. Not an as-built or completed-construction claim.
assumptions: Whole-crossing exterior reconstruction of the stated proposed design, not an as-built survey or confirmation of construction completion.
Amber / needs_detail: fabrication tolerances, exact field seats, local notches and transitions, small fittings, and terrain remain incomplete.
Internal reinforcement, shear studs, embedded anchors and welds are omitted. No rendered component is a finite element or a solid-stress result.
Any later FEM must freeze its own material, stiffness, connectivity and support assumptions. Visual mesh volume is not a section-property source.
Foundations are hidden by default; foundation envelopes are design references and do not establish actual field embedment.
The source title calls the deck simple-span while the bents are explicitly integral; an FE boundary model must state its rotational idealization and may not silently invent discrete bearings.
Vertical curve uses the sheet 11 170 ft curve, P.V.I. 507+10 El. 879.00, +0.730 %/-0.622 %, with the -0.622 % tangent east of 507+95; local datum Z = 3 m + 0.3048 (El. ft - 878.64) for every part.
Foundation cylinders show exterior envelopes only. Pipe wall thickness and estimated tip elevations are source values, not verified as-driven geometry.

source_binder.page_numbering: Unchanged one-based original primary PDF pages. Secondary sources have independent original PDF page numbers.

Not modelled: the W-beam and thrie-beam corrugation shapes and the blockouts, which sheet 3 and the cross sections draw only as an undimensioned 8 x 14 in cell (against the 12 in MGS and 7 in TGB blocks of the sheet 12 plan), and the splices, bolts, post plates and connector hardware; they are defined by the INDOT Standard Drawings for pay item 601-94689 (Guardrail End Treatment, Type OS), which the contract set does not include.

detail_coverage.detail: Proposed 30 ft span, 43 ft wide slab, both integral bents, four wings and both approach slabs. The removed 1941 structure is not retained.

Asymmetric FC rail lengths, four TFC transition envelopes, joint strips and the guardrail runs to the sheet 11 limits (three MGS Without Curb transitions, the Type TGB transition, the 87.5 ft MGS W-beam run, three Type OS end treatments and the curved Type 1 terminal) with drawn post positions and envelope sections.
Two rows of eight 14 in pipe pile exterior envelopes; 8 ft spacing is measured along the 45 degree support line. Hidden by default.

Rebar and internal pile material, actual driven lengths, soil and rock, riprap, flowable backfill behind the wings and bents, the 1 1/2 in bent fillet, the 1 in PEJF, exact FC/TFC fillets and guardrail hardware (standard drawings).

known_deviations.deviation: The guardrail runs follow the drawn layout (pay limits, post positions, spacing and 7 ft posts, rail line, curved terminal path, thrie/W-beam heights, drive grade), but the rail is a flat 0.085 m plate instead of the W-beam and thrie-beam corrugations, the posts are solid rectangles, and blockouts, splices, bolts, post plates, connector hardware, the Type OS impact heads and the terminal anchor and cable are not modelled. The curved terminal keeps the TGB rail height.
known_deviations.reason: The plans draw these items only as undimensioned schematic cells: the W-beam profile and an 8 x 14 in blockout in the sheet 3 typical section and the sheets 23-28 cross sections (the same cell at thrie-beam stations), which conflicts with the 12 in MGS and 7 in TGB blocks of the sheet 12 plan; sheet 11 shows the end heads and the anchor only as outlines; no sheet gives the terminal rail height. They are defined by the INDOT Standard Drawings and Standard Specifications Section 601 for the pay items 601-12292 Guardrail Transition, MGS Without Curb; 601-01522 Guardrail Transition, Type TGB; 601-12281 Guardrail, MGS W-Beam, 6 ft 3 in. Spacing; 601-94689 Guardrail End Treatment, Type OS; and 601-01700 Guardrail Terminal System, W-Beam, Curved, Type 1 (revision notice 9710491 p. 5), which the contract set neither includes nor cites by drawing number.

decisions.decision: Approach slab end 1'-2" deep from 18 in beyond the bent back face onto the 9 in ledge, 2 in chamfer to the 12 in slab.
decisions.reasoning: Sheet 19 Section E-E dimensions it: 1'-6" beyond the bent plus the 9 in ledge, with a 2 in step at 45 degrees. Sheet 17 End Bent Detail (depths 1'-0", 1'-2", 1'-8" dimensioned) scales the same 18 in + 2 in, and the wing elevations on sheets 15 and 16 draw the 1'-2" zone 38.1 in long along the skew (27 in normal). Sheet 18 railing elevations scale 15 in but are schematic there: they draw the slab 18 in deep against the dimensioned 1'-8".
decisions.rejected_reading: Sheet 18 north/south railing elevations: 1'-2" zone 15 in beyond the bent back face.
decisions.sources: sheet 19 Section E-E; sheet 17 End Bent Detail; sheets 15, 16 wing elevations; sheet 18

decisions.decision: Guardrail posts 7'-0" long with 52 in below grade.
decisions.reasoning: Every cross section through the runs (sheets 23-28, Sta. 505+99 to 509+00) draws the post 7.01 ft long with about 52.7 in below the ground, and the sheet 18 railing elevations draw the posts next to the TFCs 7'-0" long, 52 in below the deck line. Only the sheet 3 typical section draws a 6'-0" post. Post tops follow sheets 12 and 18 (1 in above the rail; TGB posts 1-8 at 31.4 in and 9-10 at 27.4 in), so the TGB and terminal posts are up to 4.6 in shorter than 7 ft.

decisions.sources: sheets 23-28 cross sections; sheet 18 railing elevations; sheet 3

decisions.decision: Type TGB posts at the sheet 12 plan positions: first post 11.47 in beyond the TFC end, 5 x 1'-6 3/4", 3 x 3'-1 1/2", 1 x 6'-3" to the post on the 507+94.74 pay limit.

The sheet 18 north railing elevation and the sheet 12 elevation draw the same spacings but start 1'-5 1/2" from the TFC end, 6 in further out, which leaves a 5'-9" last bay that matches neither plan.
